name: Biatorbágy (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of pale blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the town arms of Biatorbágy: a crowned pale blue shield with ears of grain and ploughshares, between roses and green branches.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Biatorbágy arms with crown, roses and branches
